'''Jonus''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[TIE pilot]] who served with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], earning his [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] and becoming a [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. At one point being attacked and narrowly escaping [[Death/Legends|death]] by an [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorth]], Jonus became a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] with the Empire's [[Gamma Squadron/Legends|Gamma Squadron]], and scored several kills against [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]].

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Jonus joined [[Scimitar Squadron (Imperial)/Legends|Scimitar Squadron]], an elite [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] which was tasked with destroying any ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]] or equipment that might land on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], where the [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator]] protecting the Empire's [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. In 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] ended with the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] destruction, with Jonus and other TIE pilots attempting to evacuate the [[Space station/Legends|station]].

==Biography==
[[File:Scimitar2-CCGDS2.jpg|left|thumb|Scimitar 2, Jonus's TIE/sa bomber]]
Jonus was a [[TIE pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. He served with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]],<ref name="CCG-Jonus" /> earning his [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] and becoming a [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. At one point during Jonus's Imperial service, he was attacked by an [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorth]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|172|Jonus, Captain}}</ref> and the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] narrowly escaped [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="CCG-Jonus" />

Jonus at some point flew a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] with the Empire's [[Gamma Squadron/Legends|Gamma Squadron]].<ref name="Corellian" /> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|11|END 7-10|The Battle of Endor}}</ref> Jonus had scored several kills against [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], and joined [[Scimitar Squadron (Imperial)/Legends|Scimitar Squadron]],<ref name="CCG-Jonus" /> an elite TIE/sa [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]].<ref name="CCG-Rhymer">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Major Rhymer}}</ref> Jonus often flew as top cover during [[Bomb/Legends|bombing]] runs and operated [[Scimitar 2]],<ref name="CCG-Jonus" /> a TIE/sa bomber stationed on the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="CCG-Scimitar2">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Scimitar 2}}</ref>

Prior to 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY's]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Scimitar Squadron was stationed in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] and assigned with destroying any ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]] or equipment that might land on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]],<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|11|END 7-10|The Battle of Endor}}</ref> which contained the [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator]] protecting the Empire's [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. The Battle of Endor ended with the Death Star's destruction, and Jonus was one of the TIE pilots who attempted to evacuate the [[Space station/Legends|station]] before it was destroyed.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Skills and abilities==
Captain Jonus earned his rank through his service with Death Squadron.<ref name="CCG-Jonus" /> He was also a disciplined instructor.<ref name="Corellian" />

==Equipment==
Jonus wore the standard TIE pilot [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Jonus-DSII.png|thumb|right|250px|Jonus attempting to escape the Death Star, as seen in ''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]
Jonus first appeared in [[1983]]'s [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="ROTJ" /> in a scene filmed between [[February 25]] and [[March 1]], [[1982]] at [[Elstree Studios]]'s stage 6.<ref name="making">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> He was named in the [[2000]] ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG-Jonus" /> The image used for Jonus's card is a modified version of a TIE pilot promotional image, thus linking him to that pilot [[in-universe]].<ref name="AFA">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref> In [[2012]], [[Fantasy Flight Games]] released ''[[Star Wars: The Card Game Core Set]]'', which included a card showing an illustration of Jonus operating a TIE/sa bomber.<ref name="SWTG">{{FFGTCG|set=Star Wars: The Card Game Core Set|cardname=TIE Bomber|link=core/tie-bomber-core-27-4}}</ref> However, it was only made clear in [[2013]]'s ''[[TIE Bomber Expansion Pack]]'' of Fantasy Flight Games's ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game]]'' that Jonus was the pilot of one of the TIE/sa bombers in the earlier card game.<ref name="TIE Bomber">{{FFGXW|set=TIE Bomber Expansion Pack|cardname=Captain Jonus}}</ref>
